cases.input: An employer leases office units in a building it does not own.
cases.expect: Spatial units retain building containment and office designation; lease and ownership remain external.

cases.input: The building address changes while boundaries and authority remain stable.
cases.expect: Site building and spatial-unit identities remain unchanged; only location references change.

cases.input: One unit changes use from office to laboratory.
cases.expect: Issue a successor use designation without changing spatial identity.

cases.input: One floor unit is divided into three separately governed suites.
cases.expect: Original unit retires and three successor identities preserve split lineage.

cases.input: A room moves between administrative floor groupings without boundary change.
cases.expect: Containment assertion changes while room identity remains stable.
No residential premises or public home address is minted; workplace allocation stores only permitted generalized locus externally.

cases.input: A pooled desk is reserved for one day.
cases.expect: Booking does not create a new premises identity use designation or access grant.

cases.input: A room is given parallel WM-BLT-002 and WM-PLC-009 identities.
cases.expect: The second identity is rejected; indoor topology is a profile over WM-BLT-002.
